args.prompt: Explain in three sentences what a Mixture-of-Experts model is.

results.response: A Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model is a type of architecture that builds upon a large model by using multiple specialized sub-networks instead of a single large one. Instead of using the entire model for every task, it only activates a subset of its parameters for each specific input, a process known as "routing." This allows the model to achieve high performance by only using the most relevant parts, providing the intelligence of a massive model with the efficiency of a smaller one.
